probe: Same held-out documents and fixed post-training victim state, dropout disabled. Training probe exposes next-token-loss seam gradient; inference exposes activations only. No probe updates. This is not an online training trajectory.

statistics.unit: crossed document and independently trained victim run; average attack seeds first
statistics.secondary_correction: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap intervals across all prespecified secondary contrasts
statistics.missing: No complete-case deletion. Any missing/failed cell blocks comparative analysis; retain failure and rerun entire run in a fresh directory with same protocol.
statistics.stopping: Exactly 256 fixed evaluation documents,128 fixed victim-training documents,32 fixed calibration documents and10 independent training seeds; no outcome-driven sample extension. Report achieved precision; no power guarantee.
statistics.generalization: Crossed bootstrap accounts for evaluation documents and victim training randomness, conditional on this single fixed128-document training corpus. It does not estimate variation across independently sampled training corpora.

data: Disjoint calibration, victim-training and untouched evaluation documents; pinned tokenized input and annotations hash required. Names annotated before predictions. Evaluation text is public benchmark text, not evidence of actual sensitive-data harm.
compute: Measured per-arm online work plus applicable model loading, public calibration, and exact-head export cost. Report cold and amortized costs; victim training is separate. No equal-cost claim across SIPIT and beam. Randomized arm order.
baseline_gap: Backward direction remains heuristic; SIPIT is existing budgeted independent implementation. BiSR is not included or claimed reproduced.

execution.meaning: Inference forward/SIPIT rows reference the corresponding measured training-probe execution because h, head, calibration, attack seed and budget are identical. Reused rows are not additional runtime measurements.
execution.checkpoint: Per-cell hash-chained measurement events and immutable predictions; report checkpoint after each victim run and at completion/failure. No outcome-based retries.

annotations.source: AI-assisted pre-outcome semantic names; deterministic lexical number/identifier proxies
annotations.limitation: Name metric is descriptive and requires independent human adjudication for gold-label claims. Only2 identifier spans; identifier recovery is a case report, not a population estimate.

budget_review.planning_contingency: 25–50% scenario, about133–160GB10 GPU-hours; excludes training/setup/capture/scoring/I/O/analysis. Not a guaranteed bound.

capture_defenses.budgets: forward_k at candidate_counts {8,16,32} and sipit_steps at {32,64,128}, at both frozen depths {3,6} and all frozen victim seeds, attack seeds and knowledge conditions
capture_defenses.paired_control: The undefended training-mode forward_k and sipit_steps arms already in the matrix at identical depth, victim seed, attack seed, knowledge and budget are the prespecified paired controls; defense-minus-control is computed paired within victim run.
capture_defenses.utility_reporting: Every defended victim run reports held-out evaluation NLL alongside recovery; a defended arm is interpretable only together with its utility cost.
capture_defenses.inference: Defended arms enter as a prespecified paired descriptive comparison against the undefended control arms. The v1 inferential contrast family (primary plus 47 Bonferroni-corrected secondary contrasts) is unchanged.
capture_defenses.execution_status: Scheduled, validated and budgeted in v2. Defended-victim capture execution is not implemented in the frozen runner yet (it fails closed on defended arms); no v2 execution may start until that support lands.

record.summary: Add defended-capture arms for the two utility-viable trained defenders (replica-median, secret-mixup) to the frozen validation matrix, justified by the defended development pilot (results/pilot-defended-v1). Everything else is identical to frozen v1: same corpus and frozen_inputs, same depths {3,6}, victim seeds, attack seeds, budgets, controls, primary/secondary contrast family, statistics and no-retries policy.

value.budgets: forward_k at candidate_counts {8,16,32} and sipit_steps at {32,64,128}, at both frozen depths {3,6} and all frozen victim seeds, attack seeds and knowledge conditions
value.paired_control: The undefended training-mode forward_k and sipit_steps arms already in the matrix at identical depth, victim seed, attack seed, knowledge and budget are the prespecified paired controls; defense-minus-control is computed paired within victim run.
value.utility_reporting: Every defended victim run reports held-out evaluation NLL alongside recovery; a defended arm is interpretable only together with its utility cost.
value.inference: Defended arms enter as a prespecified paired descriptive comparison against the undefended control arms. The v1 inferential contrast family (primary plus 47 Bonferroni-corrected secondary contrasts) is unchanged.
value.execution_status: Scheduled, validated and budgeted in v2. Defended-victim capture execution is not implemented in the frozen runner yet (it fails closed on defended arms); no v2 execution may start until that support lands.

changes.rationale: Pilot (30 cells, defenses x splits {3,6} x seeds {11,22,33}, matched attacker access, development corpus disjoint from the frozen corpus): replica-median cut token recovery by 66.7-71.2 pp (forward) and 85.9-89.3 pp (SIPIT) versus the paired undefended control at a utility cost of +45.3..+49.1 PPL; secret-mixup cut recovery by 5.8-7.2 pp (forward) and 8.6-11.3 pp (SIPIT) at +35.1..+36.3 PPL. These are the two trained defenders that reduced recovery without destroying held-out utility, so the undefended-only frozen matrix cannot answer the scientifically meaningful question whether the leakage ranking survives viable defenses; the defended arms are added at the frozen splits/seeds/budgets because the pilot demonstrated feasibility there (per-cell attack 47-286 s on GB10; all 30 cells in well under an hour), not because those settings maximize leakage. Arm choice is driven by pilot feasibility and scientific meaning only. Pilot scope caveats: 3 victim seeds (wide intervals), development corpus, in-repo re-implementations, not confirmatory.

decisions.rationale: The pilot shows trained-bottleneck drives token recovery to 0.00% at both splits (paired -87.6..-91.6 pp forward, -89.3..-93.5 pp SIPIT vs none) but destroys held-out utility: PPL after is 66M-124M versus 48.3 undefended (paired delta CI lower bounds above 16M). A defense that destroys utility is not a viable defense configuration, and adding it to the frozen matrix would measure an artifact of a broken configuration, not a security property. It is excluded from v2 and will be considered only if a utility-viable bottleneck configuration is later demonstrated on development data. The pilot's bottleneck consumer arms (representation-privacy bottleneck/gram) also reported label_accuracy=None, a consumer tooling gap recorded here rather than hidden.

The random-candidate control is a mechanism control that must exist at every candidate budget K to remain paired with joint_true_k and forward_k at that K (the analyzer enforces identical prefix work per K). The pilot and baseline analyses contain no measurement of random-control redundancy across K, and the defended pilot did not vary candidate budgets at all, so there is no evidence that any K carries no information. Pruning without evidence would unpair the prespecified contrasts; all K values stay.

Null result in both pilots: no significant recovery effect (paired intervals include ~0) and no utility cost. Adding a demonstrated-null defense arm would spend budget without scientific content; gaussian noise already appears in the matrix as gradient_conditions noise_0.1/noise_1.0 controls.
